name: GCSE Statistics: Quartwren
subtitle: Revision, labs and mock papers
shortDescription: Adaptive GCSE Statistics revision: 104 specification points, 856 original questions, eight hands-on labs, guided builds and timed mock papers.
longDescription:
GCSE Statistics: Quartwren is a personalised, adaptive revision app for GCSE Statistics in England. It follows the Department for Education subject content and maps every point to the AQA 8382 and Pearson Edexcel 1ST0 specifications, with Higher-tier content marked.

### Learn
- 39 short lessons in syllabus order with worked examples, key terms and exam technique
- Switch to Real-World mode to learn by solving small fictional enquiries step by step
- Eight units: planning and collecting data, sampling, representing data, averages and spread, time series and index numbers, correlation and regression, probability, estimation and quality control

### Practise
- 856 original questions across 104 specification points, from recall to stretch
- Adaptive quizzes of any length pick your weakest and unseen points first
- Wrong answers link straight to the lesson that teaches the idea, then a short retry
- Unit tests and timed mock papers; calculation answers are checked by two independent routes

### Explore
- Hands-on labs: histograms and frequency density, box plots and outliers, probability simulator, sampling (free)
- Scatter and regression, the Normal curve, moving averages, capture-recapture (Plus)
- Guided builds: design a questionnaire, draw a fair sample, clean a messy data set, run a statistical enquiry (Plus)

### Check
- A Coverage screen lists every specification point with its DfE, AQA and Edexcel reference and question count
- An Other boards map shows where each unit continues in A Level, IB and AP Statistics

QUARTWREN PLUS (optional)
One monthly subscription (US$2.99). Cancel at any time in your store account settings: cancelling takes effect from the next billing period, so you keep Plus until the end of the month you paid for. The free part stays free: units 1 to 3 with their lessons, quizzes, unit tests and four labs.

Text size from 50% to 300%, on phones and tablets. Not affiliated with or endorsed by AQA, Pearson Edexcel, Ofqual or the Department for Education. Original practice material; check your own board's specification.
monetization: Free core course, optional monthly Plus
